looking_for_a_team_that_actually_fits: Looking for a team that actually fits?
we_place_creative_people_with_studios_an: We place creative people with studios and brands who value fit as much as skill. Send us your portfolio and what you're looking for — we'll reach out when the right role comes up.
1_send_your_portfolio_and_what_you_re_lo: 1Send your portfolio and what you're looking for
2_we_keep_you_in_mind_as_roles_come_up: 2We keep you in mind as roles come up
3_we_only_reach_out_when_it_s_a_genuine_: 3We only reach out when it's a genuine fit
c_roles_body: Graphic and UI designers, copywriters and content writers, social media specialists, videographers, video editors and motion designers, plus art directors and creative leads — mostly for studios, agencies and in-house brand teams.
c_look_body: Craft you can show, and the way you work with people. We read portfolios properly, and we ask how you like to be briefed, managed and grown — because that is usually what decides whether a role lasts.
c_send_title: Four things that make your portfolio easy to place.
c_send_1: A link that opens without a password — a site, PDF, Behance or Drive folder is fine.
c_send_2: Which parts of each project were actually yours, especially on team work.
c_send_3: The kind of role and team you want next, not just the job title.
c_send_4: Where you are based, and whether you want remote, hybrid or on-site.
c_q1: Will you share my portfolio without telling me?
c_a1: No. We ask you first, every time, before your name or work goes to a company.
c_q2: I did not hear back. Does that mean no?
c_a2: It usually means there is no matching role open right now. We keep portfolios on file and reach out when something genuinely fits, which can be months later.
c_q3: I am still employed. Is that a problem?
c_a3: Not at all, and we keep it confidential. Most people we place are working when they first talk to us.
